name: 1 · Original
rationale: The original paper, unchanged as the control.
tradeoff: The palest reference: judge how clearly its edge separates from ceramic.

name: 2 · Original + warmer
rationale: 50% original + 50% warmer ivory. A restrained increase in warmth.
tradeoff: Tests whether a small warm shift gives enough separation without the full ivory cast.

name: 3 · Original + mineral
rationale: 50% original + 50% mineral. A softer green-grey paper.
tradeoff: Tests a quieter mineral tint while keeping the original paper’s lightness.

name: 4 · Warmer + mineral
rationale: 50% warmer ivory + 50% mineral. Warm and green undertones meet.
tradeoff: Tests a balanced, deeper neutral between ivory and mineral.
